description: This file contains API functions for fetching user-related data, including user projects and basic user info from a backend service. It uses an API client to make HTTP GET requests and includes inline documentation.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a user's projects based on userId and optional parameters such as tenantId, organizationId, and date ranges, returning a Promise with project data.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId)
methods.description: Retrieves minimal user information given a userId, with special handling for 404 errors returning null for the name candidate.
